title: Gideon and the Terminal
author: Lena Blackwood
blurb: Marguerite Thackeray, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
